description: Angular component for displaying recent dashboards with functionalities like star/unstar dashboards, navigation, and data subscription management.

classes.name: RecentDashboardsWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing and displaying recent and starred dashboards, including data subscriptions and UI interactions.

classes.name: LastVisitedDashboardsDataSource
classes.description: Data source class for handling paginated last visited dashboards data, integrating with Angular CDK collections.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets user info, and creates data subscriptions if applicable.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches user dashboards info and initializes data sources.

methods.name: createDashboardUrl
methods.description: Generates URL for a dashboard based on its ID and fullscreen mode.

methods.name: toggleValueChange
methods.description: Switches between 'last' and 'starred' dashboards view and reloads data accordingly.

methods.name: initLastVisitedDashboardsDataSource
methods.description: Initializes the data source for last visited dashboards with sorting and paging.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up subscriptions to sort change events for dashboards.

methods.name: updateLastVisitedDashboardsData
methods.description: Updates data source based on current sort order.

methods.name: hasLastVisitedDashboards
methods.description: Checks if there are last visited dashboards available.

methods.name: toggleDashboardStar
methods.description: Stars or unstars a dashboard and updates user settings.

methods.name: onStarDashboard
methods.description: Adds a dashboard to starred list and reports action.
